messages:
sara_ng: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (AUTH_PROXY_HEARTBEAT) triggered for prod-us-west-2 edge-proxy cluster — sudden spike of 401/403s and abnormal outbound connections to s3-external-collector. Paging @devon_oncall.

pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-045 created by PagerDuty (severity: high). Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-045

devon_oncall: On it. Starting with tracing and recent deploys. Any deploys in the last hour?

mike_ops: No prod deploys in the last 2h. Seeing an uptick from a small set of client IPs (CN, RU). I can pull proxy logs.

ida_prodsec: From the brief telemetry — we see Authorization header fragments in the proxy-forwarder logs. Could be accidental debug forwarding to the external sink. If true, we need containment + key rotation.

mike_ops: Pulling logs now: ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/edge-proxy --since=30m | grep -i \"Authorization\" | tail -n 50```

mike_ops: snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T14:07:12Z] proxy=edge-proxy-12 auth=\"Bearer eyJhbGci...\" forwarded_to=s3://external-collector/2026-03-19/trace.json
[2026-03-19T14:07:13Z] proxy=edge-proxy-12 client_ip=45.76.89.10 request=/v1/generate status=401
```

devon_oncall: That log line looks like a literal Authorization header leaked to the forwarder. Is the forwarder a third-party integration?

ida_prodsec: Yes — it's a legacy telemetry forwarder we agreed to deprecate. It uploads to an external S3 bucket (not customer data encrypted at rest with our KMS). We need to: 1) stop forwarder ingestion, 2) quarantine the bucket, 3) rotate affected tokens/keys, 4) assess customer impact.

jordan_support: Flagging that at least one paying customer in EU reported intermittent auth failures ~14:10 UTC. I'll prepare an interim customer message template but holding until we confirm scope.

devon_oncall: Immediate actions I will run now:
- `kubectl scale deploy/telemetry-forwarder -n infra --replicas=0` (stop uploads)
- block egress from forwarder: `nsxctl apply deny-e2e-forwarder-egress`
- add firewall rule to block traffic to s3-external-collector domain

mike_ops: Confirmed forwarder scaled to 0 and egress blocked. Stopping uploads returned HTTP 200 for the stop job.

ida_prodsec: Next, we need to rotate the service account token used by edge-proxy that may have been captured. Targeted rotation plan:
- rotate edge-proxy service account keys (IAM) and create new creds (runbook: /runbooks/rotate-service-account.md)
- revoke old tokens via KMS/key registry and invalidate sessions with `authz-svc`
- schedule rolling restart of edge-proxy pinned to new env var `PROXY_SERVICE_TOKEN`

devon_oncall: I can do the IAM rotate and kick authz invalidation. Mike, can you handle the rolling restart once new token is injected?

mike_ops: On it. ETA ~12m for restart after token is ready.

ida_prodsec: Legal/security note: we should assume potential exposure of tokens to that external bucket until the bucket is quarantined and logs assessed. Initiating bucket quarantine (request submitted to infra-custodian). Also request logs export for forensic ingest into our secure S3 for analysis.

jordan_support: I'll send a brief to the affected customer(s) once we confirm: \"We are investigating an internal telemetry forwarder that may have captured service auth tokens. We have halted the forwarder, quarantinedthe external storage, and are rotating credentials. We'll follow up with scope and mitigation details.\" (will wait for final confirmation)

devon_oncall: Rotation complete. New service token issued: `PROXY_TOKEN_ROT_20260319_01` (stored in KMS path: projects/redwood/edge-proxy/rotations/2026-03-19). I invalidated old tokens via authz-svc: `POST /internal/invalidate?token=old-keys` returned 202.

mike_ops: Rolling restart done on prod-us-west-2 edge-proxy (pods recycled, readiness green). Verified requests returning 200 and no further forwarded Authorization headers in new logs.

ida_prodsec: Forensics: request a full dump of the external bucket and run pattern matching for bearer tokens, then redact and ingest into secure forensics store. Also create a ticket for a scoped secret-scan across other forwarders and staging.

jordan_support: Customer comms prepared and ready to go after forensic confirmation. Will update support case #CS-9281 with timeline.

devon_oncall: Handoff to oncall team for monitoring: mike_ops will own the follow-up for 4h. I'll create INC-2026-045-POSTMORTEM draft and assign to ida_prodsec + mike_ops + jordan_support.

sara_ng: Thanks team. Please add any post-incident action items to the incident doc and ping me if legal needs to loop. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-045 status -> mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-045/postmortem

mike_ops: Quick note: we should rotate any third-party integration keys that had write access to the telemetry bucket. Adding to action items.

ida_prodsec: Agreed. Also create a timeline entry and add the KMS rotation IDs. I'll start the forensic job and loop in infra-custodian.

jordan_support: Sending interim customer note now w/ link to support case once forensics confirms no PII.

devon_oncall: Closing handoff — monitoring for 2h, will escalate if any reappearance.

sara_ng: closing thread here. Great triage, team.
